Brown Act
 Agendas are drafted to accurately state what the legislative body is being asked to consider. The legislative body
can take action on "all items" listed on the agenda and be in compliance with the open meeting laws. Under the
Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless certain emergency or
